item.title: Who We Are
item.description: Babeta - lead vocals and pianoAs the frontman, she takes care of the melody and energy of every song. Her musical roots include, among other achievements, reaching the finals of the national Mladá píseň competition. Míra - bass and electric guitar, backing vocalsHis basslines are pleasantly smooth and melodic. This comes from a lifetime of playing the electric guitar—an instrument he mastered with such deep feeling that it earned him awards and an invitation to Michal Pavlíček’s renowned TV show, Na Kloboučku.
